sections.title: Action & Arcade
sections.description: Quick reflexes, high scores, and Burlington-sized chaos.

sections.title: Daily Puzzles & Quizzes
sections.description: Words, trivia, local knowledge, and fresh reasons to come back.

sections.title: Board & Card Classics
sections.description: Familiar favorites rebuilt with a Vermont twist. Solo vs the bot, pass the phone, or play online — bot wins make the leaderboard.

sections.title: Party & Community
sections.description: Pass the phone, share a laugh, or let the town decide.

sections.title: Local Challenges & Stories
sections.description: Take the arcade into Burlington, or dig into the Brief.

sections.title: Party Night
sections.description: Live games for a whole room — everyone scans a QR code, phones stay mostly pocketed, and the reveals land together on a big screen (or read aloud by whoever's hosting). Built for Btown Brief meetups and mixers — or your own living room. Anyone can host, free, no accounts.

games.name: Church Street Skate
games.pitch: Skate real downtown Burlington in 3D — ollie the City Hall steps, grind the planters, bomb College Street to the lake.
games.boardHint: Trick points from your best skate session.

games.name: STREET YEET
games.pitch: Ragdoll-physics yeeting on Church Street. Creemees, syrup jugs, leaf peepers. You know what to do.
games.boardHint: Yeet points — bigger launches, bigger score.

games.name: Church Street Runners
games.pitch: Run down Church Street Marketplace: dodge dogs, grab creemees, catch live headlines.

games.name: FILED!
games.pitch: Two thumbs, one goal: survive the World's Tallest Filing Cabinet.

games.name: Flappy Champ
games.pitch: Flap Champ, Lake Champlain's monster, through the schooner sails.

games.name: Champlain Glider
games.pitch: Dive the hills, ride the sunset across Vermont, and outrun the night.

games.name: Tap the Maple
games.pitch: Knife-Hit sugaring season: tap taps into the maple, don't hit the taps.

games.name: Creemee Drop
games.pitch: Catch falling swirls and stack Vermont soft-serve to the sky.

games.name: Pothole Patrol
games.pitch: Patch Burlington's potholes before mud season swallows the street.

games.name: Btown Hangman
games.pitch: One Burlington word a day, six lives — save the little chalk guy.
games.boardHint: Lives kept ×10,000 + speed bonus — a clean no-miss save tops the board.

games.name: BTown Wordle
games.pitch: A fresh Burlington-flavored word puzzle every single day.

games.name: Trivia Ladder
games.pitch: Climb the Burlington trivia ladder: one wrong rung and you fall.

games.name: Where in BTown?
games.pitch: One local photo, one guess: name the Burlington spot.

games.name: News Quiz
games.pitch: How closely did you actually read this week's BTown Brief?

games.name: Real or Fake
games.pitch: Actual Burlington headline, or did we make it up? Trust your gut.

games.name: Earlier or Later
games.pitch: Two moments in Burlington history: which one happened first?

games.name: Higher or Lower
games.pitch: One Burlington stat, then another. Guess higher or lower and keep the streak.

games.name: Rank What You Know
games.pitch: Put Burlington things in the right order. Sounds easy. It isn't.

games.name: Four in a Rowboat
games.pitch: Drop your buoys and line up four across Lake Champlain — race a friend or take on the Skipper.
games.boardHint: Fewest buoys to line up four — ⛵ Skipper wins outrank 🛶 Paddler wins.

games.name: Queen City Chess
games.pitch: Burlington IS the Queen City — full chess: pass the phone, race a friend online, or test the Queen City Club.
games.boardHint: Fastest checkmate — ♛ Queen City Club wins outrank 🧳 Tourist wins.

games.name: Front Porch Dominoes
games.pitch: Draw dominoes under the string lights — first to 100 wins the porch. Solo vs Porch Swing Pete, or 2–4 players.
games.boardHint: Biggest points margin — 👀 Neighbor wins outrank 🪑 Porch Swing Pete wins.

games.name: North Star Hop
games.pitch: Hop your marbles across the star under the northern lights — solo vs Polaris, or 2–4 players.
games.boardHint: Fewest hops to bring every marble home — 🧭 Navigator wins outrank ⭐ Polaris wins.

games.name: Crazy Eights
games.pitch: Eights are wild on the Burlington deck: match it or draw, first empty hand wins.
games.boardHint: Go out while Champ still holds a fistful — more stranded cards, higher score.

games.name: Maple Mancala
games.pitch: Sow maple candies bucket to bucket and capture the sweetest side of the plank.
games.boardHint: Sweetest store margin — 🔥 Sugarmaker wins outrank 🌱 Sap Run wins.

games.name: Maple Scramble
games.pitch: Sixteen tiles, one connected crossword, every day — get TAPPED fast and top the monthly board.

games.name: Kings Corner
games.pitch: Kings to the corners: shed your hand around City Hall Park before the bot does.
games.boardHint: Shed your hand in the fewest turns to outdeal the Mayor.

games.name: Btown Cribbage
games.pitch: Full cribbage on the Long Trail peg board — the app does all the counting.
games.boardHint: Beat Champ by the most points — a skunk scores 31+.

games.name: Church Street Checkers
games.pitch: Checkers on the Marketplace bricks — captures are mandatory, no mercy.
games.boardHint: Fewest moves to beat the bots — a 🎩 Marketplace Master win outranks every 🍦 Stroller win.

games.name: Battle on the Lake
games.pitch: Hide your fleet on Lake Champlain, then sink theirs — ferry, schooner, kayak and all.
games.boardHint: Sink the Harbormaster's fleet in the fewest shots — a perfect 17-shot hunt scores 84.

games.name: Btown Crossings
games.pitch: Our own word-tile board: Church Street doubles your word, the Waterfront triples a letter.
games.boardHint: Your highest winning score against SKIP.

games.name: Sugarbush Squares
games.pitch: Claim plots in the sugarbush: close a box, plant a maple, go again.
games.boardHint: Widest winning margin — a 🔥 Boiler win outranks every Sap Hauler win.

games.name: Peak Foliage
games.pitch: Flip the forest green or red — whoever hits peak foliage wins the canopy.
games.boardHint: Widest leaf margin — 🌲 Forester wins outrank 🍁 Peeper wins.

games.name: Snowball Slinger
games.pitch: Sling snowballs at squirrel forts across 3D Burlington — win back the maple candy.

games.name: Stay Awhile
games.pitch: Spin the wheel, land on someone, ask them something that isn't small talk.

games.name: Burlington Days
games.pitch: Days people actually had here. Take one and it's rebuilt for your date — hours, weather and what's on, all checked. Burlington only.

games.name: Who's Playing
games.pitch: Find someone to play with — or find the game. Partners and pickup sports, Burlington only.

games.name: Up For It
games.pitch: Say what you'd go to. Five taps and it tips; a host picks it up and it's on. Burlington only.

games.name: Lake Breath
games.pitch: A Lake Champlain meditation: breathe with the motion light, paddle the water, and let it go.

games.name: Btown Challenges
games.pitch: Real Burlington challenges — eat it, climb it, streak it — then put your name on the board.

games.name: Caption This
games.pitch: BTown's weekly caption contest: swipe on the funniest, or write your own.

games.name: Maples to Maples
games.pitch: The weekly party game: one prompt, your best answer, the town votes.

games.name: The Archives
games.pitch: More of a reader? Search every BTown Brief ever written — find that story you half-remember.

games.name: Btown Party
games.pitch: One room code, five games: read the room, spin tall tales, write together, blend in, finish the chain. Anyone can host.

games.name: Dibs
games.pitch: Burlington is 920 blocks. Stand in one, tap, it's yours — until someone takes it back. Hold for points, rep your crew.
